question: Who set a new world record by becoming the first man to cross 75 metres in discus throw at the World Athletics Continental Tour in Ramona, April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mykolas Alekna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mykolas Alekna**, a young **Lithuanian** athlete, etched his name in sports history by setting a new **World Record** in the men’s **discus throw**.
 
• The record-breaking feat took place at the **Oklahoma Throws Series** meeting in **Ramona, USA**, in **April**. While the prompt mentions **2025**, the historical milestone of breaking the world record occurred in **2024**.
 
• He achieved a massive throw of **74.35 metres**, which successfully surpassed the longest-standing world record in men's track and field.
